apps.name: RF Monitor
apps.desc: RSSI, noise, margin and packet-rate tiles, a filled signal chart and the recently heard packets. Tap a packet for who sent it, its route, margin, size and airtime.

apps.name: Airtime
apps.desc: How busy the channel is: the live load, average, peak, a filled chart with the duty ceiling and the rx/tx split. Keeps a Home widget with the channel load while it runs.

apps.name: Snake
apps.desc: The classic, in Lua. Swipe to steer.

apps.name: Tetris
apps.desc: The classic falling-block puzzle. Swipe left/right to move, up to rotate, down to hard-drop. Contributed by samuelcoustet.

apps.name: ProTreck
apps.desc: Outdoor watch: ASTRO (sun/moon + 3 alarms), CMPAS (compass rose + waypoint), CHRONO (laps), TIMER (countdown), ALTI (altitude + trend + déniv). Swipe left/right to switch tabs. Contributed by samuelcoustet.

apps.name: SDK Test
apps.desc: Developer tool. Checks the extended Lua SDK on this board: capabilities, clock, battery, GPS, private file access, audio API, read-only SD listing, crypto against published RFC vectors, channel discovery, and buttons that TRANSMIT test messages.
The classic sliding-tile puzzle. Swipe to move, tap to restart. Keeps your best score. Contributed by pisti87.

apps.name: Wardrive
apps.desc: LoRa coverage survey. Probes every 20s and logs each reply with GPS position, altitude and BOTH link directions (how well you heard them, how well they heard you) to a CSV, then plots the run back on the map so you can check coverage before driving it again. Reference app for wada.mesh.discover.

apps.name: Nearby
apps.desc: Your contacts on a real map, sorted by distance, with bearing and a live frame counter. Reference app for wada.map, wada.ui.list, wada.geo and app.on_packet.

apps.name: GPS Compass
apps.desc: Compass rose: magnetometer or GPS course, live fix, bearing to contacts

apps.name: SD Scan
apps.desc: Finds and removes Windows malware on the SD card, like the M9 worm.

apps.name: Trip Odometer
apps.desc: GPS trip computer: distance, elapsed time, avg/max speed, min/current altitude, return-to-home bearing. Start/Stop to track, Reset to clear. Saves trip across restarts. Contributed by samuelcoustet.

apps.name: Breakout
apps.desc: Classic brick-breaker. Swipe left/right to move the paddle, swipe up to launch the ball. Clear all bricks to advance levels. Contributed by samuelcoustet.

apps.name: Ping
apps.desc: Send a mesh DM ping to any contact and measure round-trip time. Includes your GPS position so both sides see distance and bearing. Auto-replies to incoming pings. Contributed by samuelcoustet.

apps.name: MECP
apps.desc: Emergency messages in MECP code: pick severity and codes, add people and position, post to a channel. Decodes MECP lines into words. Code table: MECP by xiang-dev-1, CC BY 4.0.

apps.name: Music
apps.desc: MP3 and WAV from the SD card's Music folder, shuffle, repeat.

apps.name: Blackjack
apps.desc: Casino Blackjack (21) with split, double down, 6-deck shoe, persistent bankroll, pixel-perfect suit pips, and auto-scaling UI with double-stacked P4 controls. Contributed by halflive-743.

apps.name: Space Invaders
apps.desc: Classic alien shooter with shields, a bonus UFO and rising levels. Swipe or use keys to move, up or tap the middle to fire. Keeps your high score.
